g.text: Measured dispatch latency: baseline vs AUTO
Unrestricted resources • same token ladder; logarithmic axes in every panel
BF16 LL/RM • H7168/K8/E256 • tokens = capacity • median of two invocation averages per variant.
Open squares: separate retry allocations for 4-node 4096–8192 and 8-node 256–8192. No cross-cohort pooling.
Historical source fe66c050; full host-observed dispatch timing, not CollectiveX round-trip p50.
